video.hook: frame 1 already has a packed queue on the rail and marbles rolling through the first levels; the first marble lands on the mat at 3.2 s
video.structure: marbles leave the rail at 7 per second in three colour batches; each one runs the whole course in 4.78 s, rolls out of the front face and pushes into the picture; the heart is finished at 22.5 s, a sparkle plays and the picture holds for 2.6 s
video.model: a viral real-life-style wooden marble run Short GJ sent (blue, white and red marbles making a heart on a green mat); this one is gold, white and red

run.layout: 4 columns x 5 rows; rail (row 0) and level 1 (row 1) at 4 cubes high, then levels 2-4 one cube lower and one row closer each
course: tunnel out of the front face

picture.shape: heart (16 sin^3 t, 13 cos t - 5 cos 2t - 2 cos 3t - cos 4t), notch 5.6 radii in front of the exit hole, cut just in front of the face
picture.growth: equal-area: a marble's point sits at sqrt(marbles after it / marbles from it on) of the way from the notch to its final spot; 240 Hz spring (2.2 Hz, damping 0.9) + contact physics; same-colour marbles re-matched every frame

look.textures: baked after the trace: growth rings per block (1.25-1.75 rings per radius, late wood 13% darker), 9-wide whitewashed floor boards with end joints every 70, felt grain, faint wall mottling

text.watermark: Marble Pop, Montserrat 650, 44 px, at 0.962 of the height (under the picture)

sound.rolling: white noise through wood resonances 620/1250/2950/6200 Hz, level following the summed marble speed, left/right by x
sound.ticks: 26 per second per rolling marble, 4 ms bursts at 2.6/3.9/5.6 kHz
sound.clonk: 560-760 Hz knock, low-passed at 2.6 kHz, at the bottom of every hole
sound.felt: 240-320 Hz thud as a marble rolls out onto the mat
sound.clack: 2.7-3.5 kHz marble clack when a marble reaches the picture, plus 2-4 quieter ones
sound.finish: spark arpeggio C6 E6 G6 C7 E7 over a C5 bell when the picture is done
